name: Translate App
summary: AI translation app for text, images and PDF documents, built with Next.js, the AI SDK and shadcn/ui.
description: A translation web app that translates plain text, images and PDF documents (PDFs are parsed to text with pdf-parse) through the AI SDK and OpenAI. Built with Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui, Radix primitives and Zod, run with Bun and deployed on Vercel with Vercel Analytics; a live demo runs at talk-translate.vercel.app. The repository has moved to dryor/translate-app.
contains: translates text, images and PDF documents
AI SDK/OpenAI backend with Zod validation
PDFs converted to text with pdf-parse
Next.js + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS + shadcn/ui, run with Bun
